name: get_libraries
description: Get the design libraries associated with a Figma file. Returns two lists: (1) libraries currently added to the file (subscribed), and (2) libraries available to add (community UI kits and organization libraries). Each library includes its name, library key, description, and source type. Use the library keys from the response to scope searches with search_design_system by passing them as includeLibraryKeys.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to get libraries for.
